<?php
class OrdinaryBackedParent49 {
    public int $value = 100;
    public function parentRead() {
        echo "H|";
        return $this->value;
    }
}
class OrdinaryBackedBridge49 extends OrdinaryBackedParent49 {
    private function answer() { return 500; }
}
class OrdinaryBackedChild49 extends OrdinaryBackedBridge49 {
    public int $value = 200 {
        get {
            echo "C:", __CLASS__, "/", static::class, "|";
            return $this->value + $this->answer();
        }
    }
    private function answer() { return 13; }
}
class OrdinaryBackedGrand49 extends OrdinaryBackedChild49 {
    private function answer() { return 900; }
}
$parent = new OrdinaryBackedParent49;
$child = new OrdinaryBackedChild49;
$grand = new OrdinaryBackedGrand49;
echo (array)$parent === ["value" => 100] ? "P100|" : "BAD|";
echo (array)$child === ["value" => 200] ? "C200|" : "BAD|";
echo (array)$grand === ["value" => 200] ? "G200|" : "BAD|";
echo $parent->value, "|";
echo $child->value, "|";
echo $grand->parentRead(), "|";
echo (array)$grand === ["value" => 200] ? "G200|" : "BAD|";
$grand->value = 300;
echo (array)$grand === ["value" => 300] ? "G300|" : "BAD|";
echo $grand->value, "|";

<?php
class OrdinaryBackedLeaf49 {
    public $tag;
    public function __destruct() { echo "D", $this->tag, "|"; }
}
function ordinaryBackedFresh49($tag) {
    global $weak_returned;
    echo "G", $tag, "|";
    $leaf = new OrdinaryBackedLeaf49;
    $leaf->tag = $tag;
    $weak_returned = WeakReference::create($leaf);
    return $leaf;
}
class OrdinaryBackedLifeParent49 {
    public mixed $value = null;
    public function parentRead() { return $this->value; }
    public function __destruct() {
        $raw = (array)$this;
        $leaf = $raw["value"];
        echo "B", $leaf->tag, "|";
    }
}
class OrdinaryBackedLifeBridge49 extends OrdinaryBackedLifeParent49 {}
class OrdinaryBackedLifeChild49 extends OrdinaryBackedLifeBridge49 {
    public mixed $value = null {
        get {
            $backing = $this->value;
            echo "C", $backing->tag, "|";
            return ordinaryBackedFresh49("R");
        }
    }
}
class OrdinaryBackedLifeGrand49 extends OrdinaryBackedLifeChild49 {}
$box = new OrdinaryBackedLifeGrand49;
$weak_box = WeakReference::create($box);
echo ((array)$box === ["value" => null] ? "NULL_SLOT|" : "BAD|");
$stored = new OrdinaryBackedLeaf49;
$stored->tag = "S";
$weak_stored = WeakReference::create($stored);
$box->value = $stored;
unset($stored);
echo "STORED|";
$kept = $box->parentRead();
echo "H", $kept->tag, "|";
echo ((array)$box === ["value" => $weak_stored->get()] ? "SLOT_S|" : "BAD|");
unset($box);
echo ($weak_box->get() === null ? "BN|" : "BL|");
echo ($weak_stored->get() === null ? "SN|" : "SL|");
echo ($weak_returned->get() === null ? "RN|" : "LIVE|");
unset($kept);
echo ($weak_returned->get() === null ? "RN|" : "LIVE|");
